text:
Ashley: @channel :rotating_light: CVE-2026-2107 (FFmpeg libavcodec heap overflow) reported exploited in the wild. We run ffmpeg in media-ingest docker image. Need immediate triage and mitigation.

Mike: on it. which clusters have the ingest image? I can list tasks and start draining.

Olivia: media-ingest-prod and media-ingest-staging. Prod currently at 40 replicas processing user-upload-service.

Ravi: immediate mitigation plan: 1) block new uploads at the edge; 2) scale down workers; 3) push patched image as canary; 4) apply strict seccomp + drop capabilities; 5) turn on detailed audit logs for upload buckets.

Ashley: Agreed. @Mike can you put a WAF rule to return 503 for POST /upload/* and rate-limit retries?

Mike: WAF rule applied: `rule/id=ffmpeg-urgent-block; action=block; conditions: path:/upload/* method:POST` — returning 503 for new uploads. Traffic dropped from ~12qps to 0.2qps. :thumbsup:

Olivia: starting drain of ingest pods. Using rolling restart with zero new tasks: 
```
kubectl scale deploy/media-ingest --replicas=2 -n media
kubectl cordon $(kubectl get pods -n media -l app=media-ingest -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
```
Drained 32 pods, left 2 for canary.

Ashley: Good. Next: inventory all images that contain an ffmpeg binary. Use trivy or scan dockerfiles. Example quick check: 
```
trivy fs . --severity CRITICAL,HIGH | grep -i ffmpeg || docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}' | xargs -n1 sh -c 'docker run --rm $0 ffmpeg -version'
```
We need a complete list.

Ravi: quick ECR/CI search found images: media-ingest:v20260122, thumbnailer:v20260210, video-transcode-worker:v20251201, batch-processor:v20260105, legacy-ingest:v20201111.

Dena: Note: blocking uploads affects onboarding for some customers. I will prepare a short status update once we have a patch timeline.

Mike: Building patched image now — base distro updated pulls libavcodec 58.103.100 which contains the fix. Changed Dockerfile to use distro ffmpeg package, added seccomp profile. Pushing media-ingest:hotpatch-20260319 to ECR.

Deploy-bot: deploy started -> media-ingest:hotpatch-20260319 -> canary -> 2 pods -> cluster media-prod-us-east-1.

Olivia: Canary health checks OK after 5m. No crashes, smoke tests (small mp4 decode + thumbnail) passed. Promoting to 10 pods, keeping rate limiter.

Ashley: After full rollout, post-incident items: - enable automated image scanning in CI for ffmpeg-related CVEs - add PR guard disallowing static ffmpeg builds that bypass distro patches - RBAC: only deploy-bot and infra-admins can promote hotpatch images - Audit: enable object-level logging for upload buckets (retain 90d).

Ravi: For RBAC, proposing Helm change + IAM role `image-promoter` with `ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability` and `ecs:UpdateService` bound via OIDC to deploy-bot. I'll open a PR with policy and RBAC changes.

Mike: Also recommend rotating KMS image-signing key after rollout to mitigate replay risk. We sign images with KMS.

Ashley: Agree. Schedule KMS key rotation now. Verify verifier accepts rotated key alias for a 24h window. @Security-tooling confirm.

Security-tooling: Confirmed. Verifier uses key alias. Rotation will create a new key under same alias. Old key retained for 7 days to support rollbacks.

Olivia: Re-enabled uploads at edge with conservative rate limit 5rps + strict content-type validation. Added alert: ingest-decoder-errors > 3/min -> pager.

Dena: Posted status update to status.redwood.ai: "Investigating - Media ingestion temporarily limited due to FFmpeg security issue. Uploads limited; backlog being reprocessed. Update in 2 hours." https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2026-03-19-ffmpeg

Ashley: Final checklist for postmortem followups: 1) fleet-wide dependency updates for all images 2) add trivy/govulncheck to CI with blocking failures for critical CVEs 3) run binary-detection across registry for ffmpeg usages 4) implement RBAC PR + KMS rotation logging in audit bucket 5) write postmortem with timeline and customer impact.

Mike: Pushed hotpatch tags to all registries and opened rollout RFC with build logs and package diffs: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/rollouts/ffmpeg-hotpatch-20260319

Ashley: Thanks all. Tight coordination was great. I'll own the postmortem and create follow-ups in the security backlog. :white_check_mark:

Deploy-bot: deploy complete -> media-ingest -> all regions -> success

Olivia: will close thread 2h after postmortem draft posted.
